David plays basketball with Nina every Monday. Last Monday, David and Nina went to the park path. It takes twenty minutes to get to the park path by bike. What's more, remember to wash your hands after playing with the dog.
The park path is one of the best places in the city. David drinks milk after doing sports. The weather was snowy that day. What's more, jogging along the river clears my mind.
David hopes to visit London one day. David borrowed a book about art from the supermarket. Both of them like soup and milk. The robot can play chess — wonderful!
David and Nina had great fun there. Life is full of small surprises. Nina is interested in drawing.
